name: USD line currency conversion no-op (multiplier 1.0)
what_it_tests: A USD line falls through the IF chain to the 1.0 default, leaving unit/net/total/subtotal unchanged
proc_mechanism: Currency Conversion steps default else 1.0; Opportunity.CurrencyIsoCode='USD' reads USD PBE, no conversion
expected_behavior: No scaling; USD values pass through unchanged; Workday posts USD

prior_run.actual: Live V21 Force-repriced the USD quote 0Q0WC000003DHXZ0A4 (STICurrencyIsoCode=USD, Opp currency USD, Fortra Price Book active) THREE times (all isSuccess=true, errorResponse=[]). USD PAB-for-IBM-i line stayed byte-identical every pass: UnitPrice=NetUnitPrice=ListPrice=2324.15, NetTotalPrice=TotalLineAmount=TotalPrice=6972.45 (=2324.15x3). NO scaling and NO compounding (contrast G-03 EUR which degrades x0.9346^n per reprice). Quote header Subtotal=TotalPrice=GrandTotal=6972.45 USD, rollup = sum of line NetTotalPrice. The USD Currency Conversion default fired: Currency_Conversion_Formula__mdt USD_US_Dollar Conversion_Rate=1, Formula='* 1.0', Is_Active=true.
prior_run.evidence: Quote https://fortra--uat.sandbox.lightning.force.com/lightning/r/Quote/0Q0WC000003DHXZ0A4/view ; USD QLI https://fortra--uat.sandbox.lightning.force.com/lightning/r/QuoteLineItem/0QLWC000003iU774AE/view ; USD PBE 01uWC000005ws7oYAA (Fortra Price Book active, cur USD, list 2324.15); Currency_Conversion_Formula__mdt USD_US_Dollar (Rate=1, '* 1.0', Active); reprice body scratchpad/reprice_g05_usd.json (3 passes isSuccess=true); pass1=pass2=pass3 outputs 2324.15/6972.45 unchanged.
prior_run.notes: G-05 is the USD positive-control / inverse of the SC-3384 family (G-01 EUR catalog PASS, G-02 EUR configured FAIL, G-03 EUR partner compounding FAIL). It proves the Currency Conversion steps 33-36 (Net Total/Subtotal, Net Unit Price, Total Line Amount, Unit Price Display) are inert for USD: STICurrencyIsoCode=USD reads the currency-matched USD PBE directly and the per-ISO multiplier resolves to 1.0 (USD_US_Dollar formula '* 1.0', or IF-chain falls through to the 1.0 default), so the conversion is a no-op.
